fonts.display: 'Lateral', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Lateral Narrow', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Page canvas and card surfaces — warm off-white replaces pure #ffffff to keep the system grounded in an agricultural, paper-like register

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Secondary surface for footer, soft sections, and hairline borders that need separation from the parchment canvas without harsh contrast

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Elevated card and product-mockup surface — used sparingly to lift specific panels (like the Ledger screenshot) above the parchment base

palette.name: Loam
palette.role: Subtle dividers, card edges, and low-emphasis borders between the canvas and content blocks

palette.name: Bark
palette.role: Muted helper text, metadata, and supporting labels where a softer voice is needed than primary body copy

palette.name: Saddle
palette.role: Secondary body text and subdued icon fills — a warm brown-gray that recedes without disappearing

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, heading strokes, and the dominant border color across the system. Warm near-black with a hint of umber keeps the interface from feeling clinical

palette.name: Charcoal Olive
palette.role: Dark mode–style panels, product UI containers, and high-emphasis icon fills — used when a section needs to invert the warm page into something product-focused

palette.name: Deep Olive
palette.role: Navigation borders, icon strokes, and the most-used neutral divider in the system — a moss-toned dark that reads as organic rather than industrial

palette.name: Sage
palette.role: Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Honey Amber
palette.role: Primary action button fill — the system's singular chromatic accent for CTAs, earning attention through warmth rather than saturation

palette.name: Wheat
palette.role: Lighter amber used for heading borders, icon accents, and subtle decorative strokes where honey would be too heavy
